summary: Atlantic American Corporation filed an 8-K to disclose a Second Amendment to its Revolving Credit Agreement with Truist Bank. The amendment extends the deadline for delivering audited 2025 financials, Q1 2026 interim statements, and compliance certificates to July 31, 2026. No change in credit amount, interest rate, or other material terms. The filing is a routine covenant reporting extension, not a special situation. No special-situations event occurred.
